summary: Remediation tasks per asset, ready for ServiceNow, and more reliable attack-path reports.

new.title: Remediation tasks per asset
new.text: Findings are grouped into tasks on each asset: an update, a software upgrade per version, a bundled library (with all its paths), or a configuration change. See Remediations > Tasks per asset; a task opens its findings. Both export.

new.title: Tasks to ServiceNow
new.text: Two new ServiceNow outputs send the tasks and their findings once their Import Set table names are entered on the ServiceNow data-out connector page.

new.title: Verify table schema checks every table
new.text: The ServiceNow connector page checks each table's columns: present, missing, too short or the wrong type, and which new columns can be switched on.

new.title: More ServiceNow fields for vulnerable items
new.text: 14 more fields, such as security domain, category, risk score, tier and the fix KB, can be switched on per column under Connectors > Fields sent.

new.title: False positive on this server
new.text: An Admin can mark a software detection as a false positive for one server, with a reason, audited and reversible.

fixes.title: Attack-path reports are more reliable
fixes.text: Each part of the query is sized to the back end's own time limit, and a report is marked complete only when its row count is confirmed.

fixes.title: Where software was found is kept in full
fixes.text: Every software finding keeps its full path on every drive and the application it belongs to.

fixes.title: Plainer warning mails
fixes.text: Data-quality notices say what happened, whether anything was lost and whether you need to do anything.

fixes.title: Leaner at large installations
fixes.text: The task build, the vulnerability step and the software evidence use a fixed amount of memory at any size, with the same results.
